entries.question: Can I upload a photo of myself as my profile picture?
entries.answer: No — there is no photo upload in RackTrack. Your picture is always your first initial on a coloured gradient circle. On Profile, tap your avatar (it has a small blue pencil badge), then pick one of the 8 gradients in the "Choose your picture" sheet. The letter never changes — only the colour.
symptoms: how do I upload a photo
where is the camera/gallery button for my avatar
I only see coloured circles, no upload
can I use my own picture
entries.rootCause: Avatars are bundled preset gradients, not images: AVATARS is a fixed 8-entry list of two-stop gradients and Avatar renders the user's initial over the gradient. The only write path is POST /api/auth/avatar, which stores an index, not a file.

entries.question: I never picked a picture — where did my letter and colour come from?
entries.answer: They're assigned automatically. The letter is the first character of your username (or your email if you have no username), upper-cased. The colour is derived from that same initial, so it is identical every time you sign in. To change it, tap your avatar on Profile and pick a gradient from "Choose your picture".
symptoms: why is my avatar this colour
who chose my initial
my avatar changed to a letter
what does the coloured circle mean
entries.rootCause: resolveAvatarIndex falls back to autoAvatarIndex(username||email), a deterministic charCodeAt(0) % AVATARS.length pick, and avatarInitial upper-cases the first character of username||email.

entries.question: A teammate has exactly the same avatar colour as me — is something wrong?
entries.answer: No. Until someone picks their own, the colour is derived from their initial and there are only 8 gradients, so people collide. To stand apart: tap your avatar on Profile, then tap a different gradient in "Choose your picture". It saves as soon as you tap it.
symptoms: two users look identical in the app
same colour avatar as my colleague
duplicate avatars
I can't tell who is who
entries.rootCause: autoAvatarIndex maps the first character's char code modulo the 8-entry AVATARS list, so different initials routinely map to the same gradient, and no per-user uniqueness is enforced.

entries.question: How do I know which picture I'm currently using in the picker?
entries.answer: The one you're using has a white ring around it and its tooltip reads "Current"; all the others read "Select". Tap any other circle to switch — the sheet closes itself once the new choice is saved.
symptoms: which avatar is selected
no tick mark in the picker
can't tell which one is mine
Choose your picture
entries.rootCause: ProfilePage passes ring={idx === currentAvatar} and title 'Current'/'Select' to each preview Avatar; Avatar renders `ring` as a white box-shadow halo.

entries.question: Is my picture choice remembered, and does it show on my other phone?
entries.answer: Yes to both. Your choice is saved against your account on the server, not on the handset, so it follows you to any device where you sign in and survives signing out or reinstalling the app. You don't need to re-pick it.
symptoms: do I have to pick my avatar again
avatar reset after reinstall
different avatar on my tablet
is my picture saved
entries.rootCause: The picker POSTs to /api/auth/avatar, which writes the index to the users.avatar column and returns the refreshed user; the client then calls refreshUser(). Nothing is kept in device storage.

entries.question: I tapped a picture in "Choose your picture" and nothing happened — the sheet stayed open.
entries.answer: The save didn't reach the server; the sheet deliberately stays open so you can retry. 1) Check you have signal. 2) Tap the picture again — while it saves the circles dim and the bottom button reads "Saving…". 3) The sheet closes by itself on success. If it never closes, tap Close and try again once you're back online.
symptoms: avatar won't save
sheet stays open after tapping
Saving… stuck
picture didn't change
entries.rootCause: chooseAvatar only closes the picker when the POST returns r.ok; a network throw is swallowed by the catch, which intentionally leaves the sheet open with no error message shown.

entries.question: How do I switch RackTrack to dark mode / where is the appearance setting?
entries.answer: There isn't one. RackTrack is a single light theme (white surface, black accent) — there is no dark-mode switch anywhere in the app, and the old toggle now renders nothing. Even if your phone is set to system dark mode, RackTrack stays light.
symptoms: where is dark mode
night mode for the cold aisle
theme toggle does nothing / is missing
app stays white in system dark mode
entries.rootCause: ThemeToggle returns null and ThemeContext hard-codes THEME='light', setting data-theme="light" on <html> at mount; setTheme and toggleTheme are no-ops, so no user preference exists.

entries.question: My avatar shows a question mark instead of a letter.
entries.answer: That means the app has no username or email to draw an initial from — usually you're viewing Profile without a signed-in account (the name underneath reads "Guest"). Sign in again. If you are signed in and it still shows ?, ask your org admin to check your account has a username or email set.
symptoms: avatar shows ?
question mark profile picture
name shows Guest
no initial on my avatar
entries.rootCause: avatarInitial falls back to '?' when user.username and user.email are both absent; ProfilePage renders 'Guest' as the name under the same condition.
